title: console: a record:approval_decision block placed on any page other than an approval request's renders nothing — draw a visible notice instead of null
body:
Filing gate: **① a metadata-authoring trap**, routed here from objectstack-ai/objectstack#22538 (option B, chosen by the objectstack triage seat). Escalated by the at-tier contract review of PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22532 (`6089080726`, finding B). Filed by the objectstack triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (objectui `main` `e391f8768a`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` renders the page component type `record:approval_decision`. Its docblock (`:39`–`:40`) says: "Outside a `sys_approval_request` record page there is no request to decide on, and the panel renders nothing."
- The spec declares the type (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22532), and its placement on `sys_approval_request` pages is stated in prose only. So a block an author places on another object's record page parses, validates, and silently draws nothing.

## Acceptance

- Off a `sys_approval_request` record page, the panel draws a short, localized notice in place of null, saying it only works on approval request pages. Gate it with the same test that decides "outside" today.
- On a `sys_approval_request` record page, behaviour is unchanged. While the request row is still loading or absent, it keeps today's null.
- ⛔ No new lint or save-door rule. Triage chose the loud renderer over a new gate. A lint rule comes back only if a wrong-placement producer appears.
- **Pins:**
  - the block on a non-request record page renders the notice;
  - the block on a request page renders the panel;
  - the notice string is in the i18n bundle.

`Clause-②: no`. Dedupe: search over objectui for the approval decision panel rendering nothing off an approval request page found nothing open.
